name: ship-nort-ship
summary: Player fighter: a wide grey swept-delta, angular hard-surface, with a pointed nose fuselage, blue-banded swept wings ending in tip prongs, shoulder guns and two engine pods trailing behind the wing roots.

traits: blue glint on its right side
features.note: The dark canopy on the nose (columns 22-24, rows 4-6); must read as a separate glass part, not hull paint.

traits: tapers to a point at row 0
faceted with a bright centre ridge
features.note: The pointed nose fuselage running from the tip down past the shoulders; hard faceted panels, not a rounded cone.

traits: swept leading edge, straight trailing edge
thin, flat plates with chamfered edges
thickest at the root, tapering to the tips
features.note: Broad swept delta wings from the shoulders out to the tips; flat hard plates, not inflated.

traits: blue paint band along the leading edge
features.note: The blue leading-edge band on each wing (left shown; the right one mirrors it); a real marking that must stay blue and crisp.

traits: stand clear of the hull by 1-2 px
one each side of the nose
features.note: Two short red-tipped guns on the shoulders (columns 15 and 31, rows 6-8); must read as separate barrels.

traits: dark vents cut in on top (rows 21-22)
dark nozzle openings at the back
features.note: The two engine pods poking out behind the wing roots and tapering to nozzles at row 27; vents and nozzles recessed.

traits: dark channel cut in beside the spine (columns 19-21)
pale raised spine to its right
features.note: The dark groove down the middle and the pale raised spine behind the nose; the groove is cut in, the spine sits proud.

traits: two chevron ridges with a dark groove between
features.note: The chevron ridges on each wing behind the blue band, bending down into the tip prong; crisp creases.

traits: small red lights at columns 15 and 31, row 12
features.note: The red lights where the nose meets the wings.

traits: small blue glints beside the nose tip
features.note: The small blue canards/fins either side of the nose tip.
The grey prong each wing ends in (left shown).
